Overview

Hiroshima is a city in Hiroshima with a population of 1,201,000. A resilient city of peace and culture, home to the Atomic Bomb Dome, Itsukushima Shrine, and world-famous okonomiyaki. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
